calculation.expression: clip(-5 * EWM_mean(pct_change(close), span=5, min_periods=5) / rolling_std(pct_change(close), 20, min_periods=15), -5, 5), then cross-sectional median demean
calculation.description: Fades the exponentially smoothed recent return, scaling by lagged 20-session realized volatility. Uses only completed historical observations and is intended to retain reversal while reducing raw-return scale effects and turnover.

validation.regime_notes: Full synthetic benchmark history across 2020-2026; 15-instrument cross-section. Daily IC and ICIR exceed the benchmark admission gates, but high overlap with existing reversal artifacts requires deterministic correlation quarantine review.
